metadata.title: Ionizing feedback from massive stars in massive clusters III: Disruption of partially unbound clouds

notes: No eligible stars: the paper is a simulation study of model molecular clouds and embedded clusters, and its "unbound" stars/sinks are defined by positive total energy in each simulation's centre-of-mass frame (T:p9-b15), not by present-day unbound status from the Milky Way. No individual Galactic stellar identifiers are supplied.
